_comment: Zenodo deposit metadata template for the T5.3 release. Paste into the Zenodo 'edit metadata' form when creating a new deposit at https://zenodo.org/deposit/new. Replace <HF_USER>, <ORCID>, and the upload_type if Zenodo's UI changes its names. Reserve the DOI BEFORE uploading the parquet so the doi-back-fill into the dataset card has a real number to substitute.

metadata.title: Galaxy-ViT GZ DESI Dirichlet predictions, v1
metadata.description: Per-galaxy Dirichlet-Multinomial concentration parameters (alpha, 34 answers across the 10-question Galaxy Zoo DESI decision tree) predicted by a Zoobot ConvNeXt-nano encoder finetuned with a Dirichlet-Multinomial head on the DR8 subset of mwalmsley/gz_desi_wds. 61,440 galaxies, Apache Parquet, ~16 MB. Companion dataset card and source code on Hugging Face Hub and GitHub. Recovers known morphology relations on the labeled validation subset: macro vote MAE 0.088, macro coverage at 95% CI 0.93, Spearman bar-vs-bulge direction agreement with volunteer ground truth.

_publish_workflow: 2. Reserve the DOI BEFORE upload (top of the form) so the dataset card can reference it
3. Paste the .metadata above into the corresponding Zenodo form fields
4. Upload releases/gz_desi_dirichlet_v1.parquet AND releases/gz_desi_dirichlet_v1.meta.json (both files; the sidecar is the auditable provenance record)
6. Back-fill the reserved DOI into docs/dataset_card.md (the <ZENODO_DOI> placeholder) and re-run scripts/release_to_hf.py to update the HF card
